title: control-surface@1
description: Registered inventory of every disposition- or admission-affecting control. Registration lives here; implementation is discovered independently by scanning source for CONTROL_POINTS exports; a runtime proof per control is executed by the census. The census requires the independently-derived registration and implementation sets to be equal and every control's runtime proof to pass.

productionObservable.description: true if this control MUST appear in a genuine evaluation's production control trace; the census fails if a productionObservable control is not observed in a real run.
